name: novel-writer
description: AI-powered novel writing tool with collection management

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.start: npm run build && pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run build
scripts.clean: rmdir /s /q frontend\dist backend\dist frontend\node_modules backend\node_modules node_modules 2>nul || echo Clean completed
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.format: npm run format:frontend && npm run format:backend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:frontend && npm run format:check:backend

author: Novel-Writer Developer
